svg.text: Figure 1 · the main window: menu bar, panelled plot window, command window
probe: line, 49 rows, othId 0 — matches the othd’s groups
registry. Plot → New builds a plot.
Data / Field / View are later phases.
One row per trace. "r12" is the othd row,
not the solver node id — the two differ, and
the map file is what relates them.
Link x-axes ties every panel to one zoom.
Each series is routed to a panel when it is
created, so two cases never land on the same
axes unless that is what was asked for.
Panels are Plotly subplots in one div.
Read-only. The readers’ own stdout is teed
into a ring buffer and polled by
Picks the case, the probe set (its .map file)
and the rows, from an interactive node
picker. Drawn in full in figure 2.
Served by Flask on 127.0.0.1:8080 · reached remotely over ssh -L 8080:localhost:8080 · no auth layer, SSH is the gate
